Table: NGVS Virgo Core Region Galaxies: Basic Parameters

Byte-by-byte Description of file: apjab339ft4_mrt.txt
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Bytes Format Units    Label   Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1- 27 A27    ---      NGVS    NGVS identifier
  29- 39 F11.7  deg      RAdeg   Right Ascension in decimal degrees (J2000) (1)
  41- 50 F10.7  deg      DEdeg   Declination in decimal degrees (J2000) (1)
  52- 53 I2     h        RAh     Hour of Right Ascension (J2000) (1)
  55- 56 I2     min      RAm     Minute of Right Ascension (J2000) (1)
  58- 62 F5.2   s        RAs     Second of Right Ascension (J2000) (1)
      64 A1     ---      DE-     Sign of the Declination (J2000) (1)
  65- 66 I2     deg      DEd     Degree of Declination (J2000) (1)
  68- 69 I2     arcmin   DEm     Arcminute of Declination (J2000) (1)
  71- 74 F4.1   arcsec   DEs     Arcsecond of Declination (J2000) (1)
      76 I1     ---      Class   Membership class code (2)
  78- 81 A4     ---      VCC     VCC identifier (3)
  83- 88 F6.1   km/s     Vel     ? Systemic velocity
  90- 94 F5.1   km/s   e_Vel     ? Uncertainty in Vel
  96- 99 A4     ---    r_Vel     Reference for Vel (4)
 101-105 F5.3   mag      E(B-V)  Galactic reddening (5)
 107-110 F4.2   arcsec   FWHM    Full-Width at Half-Maximum of PSF (6)
     112 I1     ---      Det     Detection identy code (7)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Note (1): Of the isophotal center.
Note (2): See Section 3.1.
    0 = certain member;
    1 = likely member;
    2 = possible member.
Note (3): For galaxies also catalogued by Binggeli, Sandage & Tammann (1985)
          [1985AJ.....90.1681B].
Note (4): When multiple sources of velocity are available, we quote, in order 
          of preference, the velocity from SDSS, Keck, MMT, and EVCC.
   Keck = Guhathakurta et al., in preparation;
    MMT = Peng et al., in preparation;
   SDSS = Data Release 10 from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey;
   EVCC = Kim et al. 2014 [2014ApJS..215...22K].
Note (5): Ffollowing Schlegel et al. (1998) [1998ApJ...500..525S]. The 
          extinction coefficients adopted to correct each band are 
          A_g_/E(B-V) = 3.560, A(u^*^)/E(B-V) = 4.594, A(r)/E(B-V) = 2.464,
          A(i)/E(B-V) = 1.813 and A(z)/E(B-V) = 1.221.
Note (6): Determined at the location of the galaxy centre as described in 
          Section 4, step 4.
Note (7): 
    0 = galaxy detected and fitted by VCands;
    1 = galaxy detected by VCands but for which the GalFit fit failed;
    2 = galaxy identified visually but not detected by VCands;
    3 = galaxy brighter than g ~ 16 mag, which are excluded a priori 
        by VCands (see Section 3).
